generated_output.summary: When running an AgentSwarm in the Kimi Code CLI, executing the `/usage` command causes the live progress panel for the swarm to disappear from the interface, leaving it invisible even though background tasks continue to execute.
generated_output.root_cause_analysis: Due to overlapping UI overlay/panel rendering logic when a transient command panel like `/usage` is invoked, active sticky status components such as the AgentSwarm progress tracker are improperly cleared or not re-rendered upon command completion.

step_by_step_plan.title: Inspect AgentSwarm Progress Panel Rendering and Command Overlays
step_by_step_plan.description: Examine CORE_PANELS and active swarm progress tracking logic in apps/kimi-inspect/src/panels.ts and apps/kimi-code/src/main.ts to understand how transient command panels like /usage clear or suppress sticky UI components.

step_by_step_plan.title: Preserve Swarm Progress State During Transient Command Execution
step_by_step_plan.description: Modify the panel toggle and rendering sequence in apps/kimi-code/src/main.ts so that executing /usage does not permanently unmount or suppress the AgentSwarm live progress panel.

step_by_step_plan.title: Restore Swarm Visibility After Command Completion
step_by_step_plan.description: Ensure that when the /usage panel is dismissed or closed, the active AgentSwarm progress tracker automatically re-renders and reasserts its sticky position above the input box.

step_by_step_plan.title: Add Regression Test for Swarm Panel Persistence
step_by_step_plan.description: Write a test case verifying that running an AgentSwarm and invoking /usage keeps or properly restores the swarm progress panel upon command exit.

step_by_step_plan.title: Run Test Suite for Verification
step_by_step_plan.description: Execute the repository test suite via pnpm test to ensure all tests pass and no UI regression occurs.

structured_concepts.short_explanation: Managing how different overlapping panels, prompts, and persistent status bars render in a terminal UI.
structured_concepts.why_it_matters: Ensures that transient diagnostic commands (like `/usage`) do not permanently overwrite or dismiss long-running background progress indicators.
structured_concepts.connection_to_issue: Fixes the bug where invoking `/usage` causes the persistent AgentSwarm progress panel to vanish permanently from the screen.

structured_concepts.short_explanation: Tracking and querying active background services like agent swarms to decide whether their progress UI should be displayed.
structured_concepts.why_it_matters: Allows the UI to correctly re-render active background tasks after a transient view or command closes.
structured_concepts.connection_to_issue: Ensures that after `/usage` completes or closes, the UI checks the active swarm state and restores the progress panel.
